en-US.title: FieldHT
en-US.subtitle: Bluetooth Radio Control
en-US.description:
FieldHT is a native iPhone companion for Benshi UV-PRO handheld radios. Connect over Bluetooth Low Energy to manage channels, switch zones, tune VFO, configure APRS, track satellites, and control common radio settings without digging through the radio's menus.

Features:
- Connect to compatible radios over Bluetooth LE
- Browse, edit, reorder, import, and export channels and zones
- Tune VFO with split TX/RX, tones, power, scan, and dual-watch controls
- Import channel plans from CSV, PDF, and text files
- Configure APRS beaconing and position sharing
- Track satellite passes with Doppler-compensated RX/TX updates
- Use Siri Shortcuts for common radio actions
- Configure programmable buttons and supported speaker-mic settings
- Reconnect quickly to your last radio

FieldHT is designed for operators who want fast setup changes and clear status from their phone while keeping the radio focused on radio work.

Requirements:
- Compatible Benshi UV-PRO radio or supported variant
- Bluetooth enabled on iPhone and radio
- Location access for satellite features
- Network access for SatNOGS, N2YO, and repeater lookups

FieldHT is an independent client and is not affiliated with the radio manufacturer.
en-US.releaseNotes: Adds document-based channel import, a redesigned satellite mission control, BS22 speaker-mic setup, cleaner connection flows, and broader offline improvements.
en-US.promoText: Control your UV-PRO from iPhone with channels, APRS, satellite tracking, and BS22 speaker-mic setup.
